chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad the fair goldsmith narrated to us. He said: Isa ibn Muhammad al-Alawi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Sallam al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Wahid narrated to us. He said: Harb ibn al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Isma'il ibn Sadaqa narrated to us from Abu al-Jarud from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said:

When this verse, 'And We have recorded everything in a Manifest Imam' [36:12], was revealed to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), two men stood from their sitting and said: O Messenger of Allah! Is it the Torah? He said: No. They said: Is it the Gospel? He said: No. They said: Is it the Quran? He said: No. Then, Amir al-Mu'minin Ali came forward; so, the Messenger of Allah said: It is he -- he is the Imam in whom Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has recorded the knowledge of everything.

key_terms.أحصيناه: We have recorded/counted it -- refers to divine comprehensive recording
key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful -- the title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib
key_terms.إمام مبين: Manifest Imam -- a Quranic phrase interpreted as referring to the divinely appointed leader who encompasses all knowledge

ai.seo_question: What does 'Manifest Imam' in Quran 36:12 refer to according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrates that when the Quranic verse 'We have recorded everything in a Manifest Imam' (36:12) was revealed, the Prophet's companions asked whether it referred to the Torah, the Gospel, or the Quran. The Prophet denied each guess. When Imam Ali approached, the Prophet declared that Ali is the Manifest Imam in whom Allah has recorded the knowledge of everything. This hadith is a cornerstone proof-text for the Shia doctrine of the Imam as the repository of divine knowledge.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad the fair goldsmith narrated to us. He said: `Isa b. Muhammad al-`Alawi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Salim al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn b. `Abd al-Wahid narrated to us. He said: Harb b. al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Isma`il b. Sadaqa narrated to us from Abi’l Jarud from Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as). He said:

When this verse, “And We have recorded everything in a Manifest Imam” [36:12], was revealed to the Messenger of Allah (s), two men stood from their sitting and said: O Messenger of Allah! Is it the Torah? He said: No. They said: Is it the Gospel? He said: No. They said: Is it the Quran? He said: No. Then, Amir al-Mu’minin `Ali came forward; so, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: It is he – he is the Imam in whom Allah has recorded the knowledge of everything.
